diff.description: Minimal unified-ish diff as ordered -old/+new full source lines (see prompts/repair.md).

reason.description: The repair objective: what is broken and why this minimal change fixes it.

generator.description: Generator/model identity that authored this proposal; empty for curated/upstream is allowed only if cls is not generated.

matched.description: Whether the diff's -old lines are expected to already exist verbatim in the pristine source.
